name: Moldavia
description: A red field charged with a golden aurochs head between a star, a rose and a crescent.
history: Flag of the Principality of Moldavia, bearing the aurochs head used by the Moldavian princes from the 14th century. Moldavia united with Wallachia in 1859 to form Romania; the aurochs lives on in the arms of Moldova and Romania.

features.role: aurochs head with star between the horns
features.symbolism: the aurochs of Moldavia, borne since the principality's 14th-century founding legend
